reviewItem.question: Does "Istio CRDs are templated by default and can be installed and upgraded via `helm install istio-base`: This changes how CRDs are upgraded" mean a change to product-relationship:istio|name=helm (behavior-changed)?

change.before: "Istio CRDs not templated by default; Upgrade: kubectl apply -f manifests/charts/base/files/crd-all.gen.yaml or similar"
change.after: "Istio CRDs are templated by default in istio-base; Upgrade: helm upgrade istio-base; out-of-band kubectl install/upgrade of CRDs is no longer required"

proposed.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the Istio CRDs are templated by default in the istio-base Helm chart, so CRDs can be installed and upgraded with `helm upgrade istio-base` (CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources), while CRDs previously installed or upgraded with `kubectl apply` can continue to be managed that way and are also safely upgradable via Helm from this release onward.
